slides.headline: A Union army camp in the Civil *War*.
One soldier stands still, eyes on the *ground*.
His friend sits on a box, head *down*.
A paper on his knee. Maybe a letter from *home*.
In the distance, a military band is *playing*.
The song is Home, Sweet Home. The camp goes *quiet*.
Their dinner pot simmers on a small *fire*.
Gear hangs on a post. Home feels very *far*.
A red blanket, the only warm colour in *camp*.
Some officers banned the song. It made men too *homesick*.
Far from home, what song would *you* miss?
